THE OVERMAP

30 × 15 sectors · Each sector: 10 × 10 blocks · Each block: 24 × 24 tiles

STRATEGIC GENERATOR
LOCAL MAPS NOT ASSIGNED YET

Tutorial → rivers (4 edge connections) → cliffs (2) → zones → settlements → roads → gates → validation. Towns use 2 sectors; the two hard-zone cities use 3–5 each. Facilities occupy settlement sectors. Bridges round up to 1 per 5 river sectors; diagonal adjacency is prohibited.

Preparing the initial seeded world…

Generation checks and limitations
Strategic connectivity treats river and cliff sectors as barriers crossed at gates. Local terrain, bank movement and eligible tactical sector templates still need integration. Each attempt currently uses two separate river networks and a separate cliff chain in parallel corridors, with seeded orientation and meanders. These are strategic plans, not playable campaigns.
